deployment_steps.name: Foundation and host preflight
deployment_steps.prerequisite: RHEL 9 target and reviewed host/network baseline

deployment_steps.name: Dedicated LVM/XFS storage
deployment_steps.prerequisite: Operator positively identifies a dedicated disk and confirms the exact device

deployment_steps.name: Identity, groups, ACLs, and sudoers
deployment_steps.prerequisite: Verified /srv/company mount and reviewed existing local accounts

deployment_steps.name: Apache static portal
deployment_steps.prerequisite: Package availability, existing Apache ownership, and reviewed SELinux labels
deployment_steps.verification: Local HTTP response and approved remote client test

deployment_steps.name: Optional NFS server/export
deployment_steps.prerequisite: Approved private subnet, client VM, and reviewed exports/firewall/SELinux
deployment_steps.verification: exportfs output and second-VM client mount/access test

deployment_steps.name: Firewall and SELinux policy
deployment_steps.prerequisite: Console access, active zone/interface, approved source CIDRs, and rollback plan
deployment_steps.verification: Active zones, all zone rules, listening sockets, labels, and remote tests

deployment_steps.name: Scheduled backup and restore
deployment_steps.prerequisite: Verified source mount, destination capacity, and reviewed retention
deployment_steps.verification: Timer state, archive checksum, and restore to a fresh temporary directory

deployment_steps.name: Health monitoring
deployment_steps.verification: Health report compared with live measurements

deployment_steps.name: Integration and reboot acceptance
deployment_steps.prerequisite: All enabled components installed and disposable VM snapshot available
deployment_steps.verification: Acceptance checklist, reboot persistence, network tests, and restore evidence

deployment_steps.name: Optional Ansible identity example
deployment_steps.prerequisite: Private inventory, Ansible controller, and disposable RHEL target
deployment_steps.verification: Syntax check, check mode, apply, and idempotency check mode

target_acceptance_not_run: Backup/restore on the actual LVM/XFS filesystem
